bound_frozen_red_baseline.amendment_rule: No frozen red-baseline byte may change. Any ambiguity or contract change requires a new version, red evidence and separately accepted author amendment before implementation continues.

I2.meaning: Create only selection.py and shade_kernel.py to satisfy the frozen residual, comparator, midpoint-repair, success-memory, archive and pre-evaluated one-generation trace contracts.

I3.meaning: After the frozen I2 tests and the S6-I1 regression are green, create only online_state.py to satisfy rolling-history, reprofile, activation, component and ledger-neutral integration contracts.

I4.meaning: After I3 is green, create only experiment_contracts.py for metadata validation and in-memory planned dry bundles; no evaluator or optimizer execution hook may exist.

T.meaning: Run only the 10 frozen test files, AST/import/static review and exact-hash checks needed to turn the four later red files green while retaining the 29 S6-I1 passes.

G.meaning: Create local provenance commits and evidence only; do not configure a remote, push or publish.

E.meaning: Do not construct or execute an optimizer generation loop, problem adapter evaluation, benchmark, simulation, pilot, M, C1, F, C2, Stage B or TCAC workflow.

F.meaning: All tests use pre-evaluated deterministic fixtures; no objective or constraint function may be called and formal FFE remains zero.

sequential_scope_if_authorized.required_exit_gate: All 10 I2 test cases and the existing 29 S6-I1 tests pass; no frozen file changes, evaluator calls, history increments or formal FFE occur.

sequential_scope_if_authorized.entry_gate: S6-I2 exit gate passed and evidence recorded
sequential_scope_if_authorized.required_exit_gate: All 4 I3 test cases plus every prior frozen test pass; graph operations and archive reprofile remain ledger-neutral and exact fallback remains unchanged.

sequential_scope_if_authorized.entry_gate: S6-I3 exit gate passed and evidence recorded
sequential_scope_if_authorized.required_exit_gate: All 3 I4 test cases and the complete 46-test frozen suite pass; dry-run objects remain in-memory planned metadata with zero formal run packages and no evaluator callable accepted.

required_implementation_discipline: Implement in the order I2 then I3 then I4; do not create a later module before the prior slice is green and recorded.
Use the frozen tests without editing any frozen specification, fixture, test or receipt byte.
Implement the full frozen interface and invariants, not a test-specific shortcut or mock.
Reject NaN/Inf and invalid shapes as specified; use declared floating tolerances.
Preserve base_rng/graph_rng isolation and all S6-I1 exact-fallback contracts.
Record source hashes, environment, commands, direct process exits, static findings and zero-FFE accounting after every slice.
If a frozen contract is ambiguous, internally inconsistent or requires an unallowlisted edit, stop and produce an amendment candidate instead of guessing.
hard_stop_conditions: Any frozen baseline hash or byte changes.
Any frozen test fails for a reason other than the production module currently being implemented, or any previously green test regresses.
Any need to edit S6-I1 source, pyproject, frozen fixtures/tests/specifications or an unallowlisted production file.
Any need to install a dependency, access the network, configure a remote or alter the Python environment.
Any objective/constraint evaluator call, optimizer generation loop, benchmark/simulation adapter execution, formal run package or formal FFE.
Any dry-run API accepts a callable evaluator or represents a planned artifact as a completed run.
Any attempt to infer performance, superiority, novelty, convergence, robustness, physical validity or paper readiness from unit tests.
explicitly_not_authorized: editing or replacing the frozen red baseline
new tests or production modules outside the four allowlisted modules
problem, benchmark, synthetic-suite or CEC adapter execution
objective or constraint evaluation or formal FFE
pilot, M, C1, F, C2, Stage B or full TCAC
dependency installation, network, HPC, cloud, paid resources or remote Git
parameter tuning, data-dependent redesign, performance analysis or scientific claims
public release, preregistration-platform action, preprint or submission

completion_boundary.green_means: The frozen deterministic parent-kernel, online-state and evaluator-forbidden infrastructure contracts are satisfied in the recorded local environment, with the S6-I1 regression preserved.
completion_boundary.green_does_not_mean: A complete executable optimizer, problem adapters, formal experiment system, performance evidence or paper evidence exists.
completion_boundary.next_gate: After green implementation, freeze and independently restore the complete source/evidence package; then obtain a separate S6-E0 optimizer-execution and formal-FFE authorization.
